Hi team,

We need to lock the virtual full-loop for Sofia Martinez (applied for Senior Backend). Candidate is in CET and available next Tue/Wed mornings CET. Quick summary of the proposed slate (rough durations):
- 09:00 CET / 00:00 PST — Intro + hiring manager (30m)
- 09:40 CET — System design (60m)
- 11:00 CET — Coding pair (45m)
- 12:00 CET — Product + behavioral (30m)
- 12:45 CET — Debrief (30m)

Total ~3h (including 15m breaks). We want to:
1) Sequence panels to put heavy cognitive work (system design, coding) earlier in candidate day.
2) Assign a scribe for each panel (we've had missing notes on prior loops).
3) Confirm Zoom host/recording permissions — candidate consent OK (Hannah, you confirmed earlier?).
4) Add the interview grid & resume to the calendar invite (attached).

Action items: please reply with:
- Your availability (confirm which of the two days works)
- Which panel you'd prefer to sit on / scribe for
- Zoom host (Laura recommended she can host the session)

I've attached the resume and a first-pass grid (virtual_loop_grid_v1.xlsx). If we need to swap order for time-zone reasons we can, but try to keep design/coding earlier.

Thanks — I can take hiring manager slot if that helps.

—Rishi

Quick follow-up — flagging a timezone consideration. Candidate said "mornings CET" which puts the heavy sessions in our late-night PST. To reduce fatigue for panelists on the west coast I suggest:

Option A (compact, earlier CET start): 08:30 CET start — move intro to 08:30, design 09:00, coding 10:15, product 11:15, debrief 11:50.
Option B (split day): design + coding on day 1; product + behavioral + debrief on day 2 (shorter days for panelists).

I can scribe system design if Marissa can cover coding scribe. Marissa?

Also, can we confirm recording is turned off for the coding pair? We prefer recordings for design for notes, but not for live coding. Hannah — is candidate comfortable with that?

—Neha

Hi Rishi / team — thanks for coordinating and for the clear slate. Hannah ran this by me and I'm fine with either Option A or Option B. If possible I prefer Option A (compact, earlier start) — I like getting the heavy sessions done earlier in the day.

Recording preferences: OK to record the intro and system design for note-taking; I prefer the coding pair not be recorded.

Small ask: could we include a 10-minute buffer between design and coding for a short break? Long interviews back-to-back can be draining.

If you confirm times I'll accept calendar invites and upload the signed interview consent form.
